{{Top|leg|canon=Senior Senator}}
'''Senior Senator of the Republic''' was a prestigious position within the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]]. [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] was the last person to hold the post before the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], having been elected due to her efforts to uphold the principles of the Republic.
